spark_open.description: The creature is a single quadrupedal equine shown in right-facing side profile against a plain light background. It has a compact, sturdy body covered in short brown to gray-brown fur that is darker along the back and neck and paler cream-white on the muzzle, lower belly and inner legs. The head is elongated with a blunt muzzle, the neck is thick and muscular, the torso is barrel-shaped, and the four slender legs support the body with small shadows cast on the ground beneath the hooves. The overall form, proportions, coat texture and details are those of a donkey rendered in a highly detailed naturalistic style.

meta_spark.description: A four-legged equid standing in side view facing to the right, with a sturdy barrel-shaped body, long neck, and long narrow head. Its coat is short brownish-gray with a paler gray-white belly, inner legs, and muzzle. It has two very long upright ears, a short erect dark mane, four slender legs ending in single hooves, and a thin tail ending in a dark tuft.
